text: As a Repository Manager , I want to create, update and delete any records in my repository.
justificativa: CONSENSO. CRUD explicito (4.6): expert decompoe em 3 processos (create3+update4+delete4=11); AI usa ciclo unico (4). Protocolo 4.6 favorece decomposicao -> 11 e mais correto, MAS gera outlier (1 US-texto = 11 CFP) que distorce a avaliacao dos modelos (que predizem por texto). Decisao humana: (a) aceitar 11 e marcar como composta excluida do MAE, ou (b) anotar o processo primario e mover esta US para fora do conjunto de avaliacao.

text: As a camp administrator, I want to be able to notify parents all at once, so that they can be notified of any upcoming events.
justificativa: CORRECAO. Notificacao broadcast (Ex.7): E1+X2+R1+W1 = 5. Expert escreveu 6 por erro herdado do Exemplo 7 do protocolo (que rotula 5 movimentos como '6'). AI=4 omitiu o W1 (log). Resolucao protocolar: 5. CORRIGIR tambem o Exemplo 7 do protocolo.

text: As a collection curator, I want to have the repository queue my collection for replication upon ingest to our remote storage site and to display the remote replication status in each item and component page in the staff interface.
justificativa: CONSENSO -> expert. Composta 'and' (4.6): enfileirar replicacao (E1+R1+W1+X1) + exibir status (R1+X1) = E1+X2+R2+W1=6. AI agregou em 4. Decomposicao do expert e protocolar.

text: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
justificativa: CONSENSO -> expert. 'based on analysis + annotations + comments' = 3 fontes de leitura distintas + W(grava avaliacao). Expert E1+X1+R3+W1=6 captura as 3 fontes; AI usou R2 sem W.
